of Viṣṇu, MBh.
of the wife of Pratihartṛ, BhP.
स्तुति—कुसुमाञ्जलि m. ‘handful of flowers’, N. of a poem in praise of Śiva.

स्तुति—चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk.
स्तुति—टीका f. N. of wk.
स्तुति—पद n. an object of pr˚, Subh.
स्तुति—पाठक m. ‘praise-reciter’, a panegyrist, bard, herald (esp. of a prince, = 1. बन्दिन्), Pañcar.
स्तुति—प्रिय mfn. fond of praise, MW.
स्तुति—ब्राह्मण N. of wk. (or of a man), Buddh.
स्तुति—भाग m. N. of wk.
स्तुति—मङ्गल n. pl. praises and benedictions, Hariv.
स्तुति—मत् mfn. possessing or knowing hymns of pr˚, ib.
स्तुति—मन्त्र m. a song or hymn of pr˚, VarYogay.
स्तुति—वचन n. (Pañcat.) laudatory speech, eulogy.
स्तुति—वचस् n. (Śiś.) laudatory speech, eulogy.
स्तुति—वाद m. (MW.) laudatory speech, eulogy.
स्तुति—व्रत m. ‘one whose duty is pr˚’, a bard &c. (cf. -पाठक), L.
स्तुति—शब्द m. a word of praise, R.
स्तुति—शस्त्र w.r. for स्तुत-श्˚ (q.v.)
स्तुति—शील mfn. skilful in praise (v.l. श्रुति-श्˚), R.
स्तुति—सार m. N. of wk.
स्तुति—सूक्ति-माला f. N. of wk.

(आ), f. a partic. fragrant bark, L.
alum-slate, L.

स्तुत्य—व्रत m. N. of a son of Hiraṇya-retas and the Varṣa ruled by him, BhP.
praising &c.
a praiser, worshipper, RV.
praising (Sāy. ‘being praised’). See root, col. 1.
a praiser, worshipper, L.
a sacrifice, L.

1. स्तु॑क m. (= next) in केश-स्त्˚, q.v.
2. स्तुक = तोक, a child or young animal, TĀr.
a knot or tuft of hair or wool, thick curl of hair (esp. between the horns of a bull), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
(?) a hip, thigh (= जघन), Nir. xi, 32.
स्तुका—वि॑न् mfn. having tufts of hair, shaggy, RV.
स्तुका—स॑र्गम् ind. after the form of a curl or knot of hair, ŚBr.
(v.l. for शुकी) = स्लोक-घृत-धारा, BhP. (Sch.)
a knot or tuft of hair &c. (see स्तु॑का), VS.; ŚBr.
&c. See p. 1260, col. 1.

(accord. to Sāy. fr. √ स्त्यै accord. to Uṇ. fr. √ 3. स्तु; prob. connected with स्तुप॑, under √ 3. स्तु) a knot or tuft of hair, the upper part of the head, crest, top, summit [cf. Gk. στύπος], RV.; TS.; PañcavBr.

a heap or pile of earth or bricks &c., (esp.) a Buddhist monument, dagoba (generally of a pyramidal or dome-like form and erected over sacred relics of the great Buddha or on spots consecrated as the scenes of his acts),
MWB. 504

any relic-shrine or relic-casket (made of various materials, such as terra cotta, clay, elaborately formed brick or carved stone; often very small and portable, and enclosing a fragment of bone or a hair &c. of some saint or deceased relative, or inscribed with a sacred formula; these are carried long distances and deposited in hallowed spots such as Buddha-Gayā),
any heap, pile, mound, tope, Hcat.
the main beam (of a house), ĀpGṛ.
(L. also, ‘wind; fight; = कूल; = बल; = निष्प्रयोजन’).
cl. 1. Ā. स्तोचते, to be bright or propitious (प्रसादे), Dhātup. vi, 15.
a goat, L.

1. स्तुभ् (connected with √ 1. स्तु and स्तुम्भ्) cl. 1. P. (Naigh. iii, 14) स्तो॑भति (only in pres. base; 3. sg. स्तोब्धि, JaimBr.; p. Ā. -स्तुभान, RV.; Gr. also pf. तुष्टुभे; fut. स्तोभिता &c.),
to utter a joyful sound, hum, make a succession of exclamations, shout (esp. applied to the chanted interjections in a Sāman), RV.; Br.; Lāṭy.;
 cl. 1. Ā. स्तोभते, to pause, stop, cause to stop, paralyze &c. (स्तम्भे), Dhātup. x, 34 :
Caus. स्तोभयति (aor. अतुष्टुभत्), to praise in successive exclamations, celebrate, RV.

2. स्तु॑भ् mfn. (ifc.) uttering joyful sounds, praising (cf. अनु-, त्रि-ष्टुभ्, वृष-स्तुभ् &c.; accord. to some स्तुभ् in the first two comp. means ‘stopping, pausing’, the metre requiring regular stoppages or pauses; but see, अनु-ष्टुभ्)
joyful exclamation or cry, praise, RV.
a praiser, Naigh. iii, 16.
chanted, praised, hymned, Br.
trilling, shouting, praising, RV.
N. of an Agni, MBh.
a goat (cf. तुभ, स्त॑भ and स्तुनक), L.
See प्र-स्-√ तुम्प्, p. 699.
(cf. √ स्तम्भ् and स्तुभ्; in native lists written स्तुन्भ्) cl. 5. 9. P. स्तुभ्नोति, स्तुभ्ना॑ति, to stop, stupefy; expel (Dhātup. xxxi, 7; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 82).
or n. (?) a partic. part of the head of a horse, L.
स्तुवेय, स्तुषेय्य. See p. 1259.
w.r. for स्थूण्˚, q.v.
(prob. invented as a root for स्तूप below) cl. 4. 10. P. स्तूप्यति, or स्तूपयति, to heap up, pile, erect, Dhātup. xxvi, 127; xxxii, 133. [cf. Gk. στύϕω, στυϕελός ?.]
स्तूप—पृष्ठ m. ‘hard-backed’, a turtle, tortoise, L.
स्तूप—बिम्ब n. = -मण्डल, Kāraṇḍ.
स्तूप—भेदक m. the destroyer of a tope, ib.
स्तूप—भेदन n. destruction of a tope, Buddh.
स्तूप—मण्डल n. the circumference or extent of a tope, Rājat.
m., Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 64 (v.l. सूप्˚).
